children.name: Lemnoideae
children.note: Not in Mayo, Bogner & Boyce (1997), which still ranked the duckweeds as a separate family, Lemnaceae. Placed here per Haigh et al. (2022).

children.name: Awaiting placement
children.note: Genera the POWO master list accepts that neither Mayo, Bogner & Boyce (1997) nor any paper in the Aroidpedia literature archive places into a tribe. Shown so the count reconciles, not as a claim.

metadata.frame: Mayo, S.J., Bogner, J. & Boyce, P.C. (1997). The Genera of Araceae. Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. Chapter 23, Synopsis of the Classification of Araceae, pp. 78-79.
metadata.speciesCountSource: Aroidpedia POWO master export, Araceae_Exports/EXCELS/_run_log.csv (validated accepted species).
notes: MBB 1997 is a PRE-MOLECULAR frame. It is used here because it is the only source giving a complete tribe-level placement for every genus.

Haigh et al. (2022) supersede it in several places: eight subfamilies rather than seven, Calla moved into Aroideae (so Calloideae no longer stands), Zamioculcadoideae absorbed into Aroideae, and the position of Lasioideae left unresolved. Those divergences are listed in supersededBy and should be surfaced in the interface.

Genera flagged postMBB were described, resurrected or transferred after 1997. Their tribe is inferred from co-occurrence in the Aroidpedia literature archive, NOT asserted by MBB, and every one carries uncertainPlacement: true.

supersededBy.citation: Haigh, A. et al. (2022). Target sequence data shed new light on the infrafamilial classification of Araceae. American Journal of Botany.
divergences: Calloideae is not recognised; Calla falls within Aroideae.
Zamioculcadoideae (Zamioculcas, Gonatopus) is absorbed into Aroideae.
Lemnoideae is accepted as a subfamily of Araceae.
The position of Lasioideae is unresolved.
Montrichardia, Zantedeschia and Anchomanes are only moderately supported in their placements.

orthographicVariants.Stylochiton: Treated as Stylochaeton Lepr. (MBB no. 34). The POWO export uses the spelling Stylochiton throughout; worth confirming which spelling Kew currently accepts.
